narrative:
Headcount planning covers 700 FTEs. Total people cost of NOK 0.6B is 8.6% of revenue.

Capacity pressure follows volume: Global Wholesale is ahead of plan and needs the earliest staffing decision.

signals.title: FY2026 GP forecast NOK 30M short of the double-digit ambition
signals.source: SDP Q3 Forecast (9+3) vs FY2026 Budget (MyLINK CORE ambition)
signals.excerpt: Gross profit lands at NOK 1,690M (+8.2% on FY2025), NOK 30M (1.7%) below the NOK 1,720M ambition. Growth is broad across the five European markets; the gap is a mix issue, not a market issue.
